description: Deposit money into your wallet via a single hosted checkout. Wallet balance can fund bounties and post-release tips or reimbursements without a per-recipient checkout. Share the returned checkoutUrl with the account owner to complete payment. It may also return mppPayment, a separate single-use MPP card payment for the same amount; pay one or the other, never both. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.
